application_purpose_summary.elevator_pitch: COVE User Service is a reactive Spring Boot microservice that manages user authentication, registration, and onboarding workflows for the COVE platform. It provides JWT-based authentication with role-based access control (CUSTOMER and ADMIN roles), an admin-approval workflow for new user registrations, and integration with external OneView API for project performance data. The system is deployed on AWS EKS with automated CI/CD pipelines.

primary_capabilities.name: User Registration and Onboarding
primary_capabilities.description: Allows new users to register with the system. Registrations enter a pending approval state and require admin review before users can authenticate. Email notifications are sent at each onboarding stage (pending, approved, rejected).

primary_capabilities.name: JWT-Based Authentication
primary_capabilities.description: Provides stateless authentication using short-lived access tokens (30 minutes) and long-lived refresh tokens (24 hours). Tokens are stored in the database with expiration and revocation flags. Supports token refresh and revocation workflows.

primary_capabilities.name: Admin User Management
primary_capabilities.description: Enables administrators to approve or reject user registrations, activate or deactivate user accounts, change user roles, and view user details with pagination and filtering. All admin actions are logged in an audit trail.

primary_capabilities.name: Audit and Compliance Logging
primary_capabilities.description: Records all administrative actions on user accounts (onboarding status changes, account activation/deactivation, role changes) with timestamps and admin attribution. Provides paginated audit log retrieval with filtering.

primary_capabilities.name: External Performance Data Integration
primary_capabilities.description: Integrates with external OneView API to fetch project performance metrics and RAG (Red-Amber-Green) status data for clients. Provides a single endpoint for performance data retrieval.

out_of_scope_signals.signal: No password reset or forgot password functionality detected

processes.name: User Registration
processes.description: A new user submits registration details (email, password, name, company, etc.) via the /register endpoint. The system validates the email uniqueness, hashes the password with BCrypt, creates a user record with pending_approval status, and sends a pending approval email notification. The user cannot authenticate until an admin approves the registration.

actors.name: New User
actors.notes: Individual registering for a COVE account

actors.name: COVE User Service
actors.notes: Processes registration request, validates data, stores user entity

triggers.description: POST /register with user registration payload (email, password, firstname, lastname, company, etc.)

steps.name: Receive Registration Request
steps.business_description: User submits registration details via POST /register endpoint
inputs: AuthUser (email, password, firstname, lastname, company, country, designation, clientId, clientName, clientOneView)

steps.name: Validate Email Uniqueness
steps.business_description: System checks if email already exists in the database. If email exists, registration fails with error.

steps.name: Hash Password
steps.business_description: System hashes the user's password using BCrypt before storage

steps.name: Create User Entity
steps.business_description: System creates a UserEntity with onboardingStatus set to pending_approval, isActive set to false, and stores it in the users table

steps.name: Send Pending Approval Email
steps.business_description: System sends an email notification to the user informing them that their registration is pending admin approval

steps.name: Return Success Response
steps.business_description: System returns HTTP 201 Created with success message to the user

variations_and_branches.branch_description: If the email is already registered, the system throws a CustomException with status 400 and message 'User Creation Failed!'
If email notification fails, the system throws a CustomException with code 451 but user registration still succeeds (email failure does not roll back user creation)

outcomes.description: User record created with pending_approval status; email notification sent; user awaits admin approval
Registration fails due to duplicate email or system error; user receives error response

processes.name: Admin Onboarding Approval
processes.description: An administrator reviews a pending user registration and updates the onboarding status to approved or rejected. If approved, the user account is activated and an approval email is sent. If rejected, the account remains inactive and a rejection email with admin comments is sent. All actions are logged in the audit trail.

actors.name: Administrator
actors.notes: User with ADMIN role who reviews and approves/rejects registrations

actors.name: COVE User Service
actors.notes: Processes admin decision, updates user status, sends email notifications

actors.name: Gmail SMTP
actors.notes: Sends approval or rejection email notification

triggers.description: PUT /api/v1/admin/{toEmail}/onboarding-status with status parameter (approved, reject, or pending_approval) and optional description

steps.name: Receive Onboarding Status Update Request
steps.business_description: Admin submits onboarding status update via PUT /api/v1/admin/{toEmail}/onboarding-status endpoint with status and optional description
steps.authorization_notes: Requires ADMIN role; JWT token validated via JwtTokenAuthenticationFilter

steps.name: Extract Admin Email from Token
steps.business_description: System extracts the admin's email from the JWT access token to attribute the action

steps.name: Retrieve User Entity
steps.business_description: System retrieves the user entity by email from the users table. If user not found, process fails with error.

steps.name: Update Onboarding Status and Account Activation
steps.business_description: System updates the user's onboardingStatus field. If status is approved, isActive is set to true. If status is reject or pending_approval, isActive is set to false.

steps.name: Send Email Notification
steps.business_description: System sends an email notification to the user based on the new status: approval email if approved, rejection email with description if rejected, no email if pending_approval

steps.name: Log Action in Audit Trail
steps.business_description: System creates an ActionHistory record with admin email, user email, new status, description, and action type (OnBoarding Status)

steps.name: Save Updated User Entity
steps.business_description: System persists the updated user entity to the users table

steps.name: Return Success Response
steps.business_description: System returns HTTP 200 OK with success message to the admin

variations_and_branches.branch_description: User account is activated (isActive = true) and approval email is sent
User account remains inactive (isActive = false) and rejection email with admin comments is sent
User account remains inactive (isActive = false) and no email is sent
Process fails with CustomException 400 'User does not exist'

outcomes.description: User onboarding status updated to approved; account activated; approval email sent; action logged
User onboarding status updated to reject; account remains inactive; rejection email sent; action logged
Update fails due to user not found or system error; admin receives error response

processes.name: User Login
processes.description: An approved and active user submits login credentials (email and password) via the /login endpoint. The system validates the credentials, checks the user's onboarding status and account activation state, revokes any existing tokens, generates new access and refresh tokens, stores them in the database, and returns them to the user.

actors.name: Registered User
actors.notes: User with approved onboarding status and active account

actors.name: COVE User Service
actors.notes: Validates credentials, checks user status, generates and stores tokens

steps.name: Receive Login Request
steps.business_description: User submits login credentials via POST /login endpoint

steps.name: Retrieve User Entity
steps.business_description: System retrieves the user entity by email from the users table. If user not found, login fails with error.

steps.name: Check Onboarding Status
steps.business_description: System checks the user's onboardingStatus. If not approved, login fails with appropriate error (pending_approval, reject, or invalid status).

steps.name: Check Account Activation
steps.business_description: System checks the user's isActive flag. If false, login fails with error 'Your account has been deactivated'.

steps.name: Validate Password
steps.business_description: System compares the submitted password with the stored BCrypt hash. If passwords do not match, login fails with error 'Invalid username or password'.

steps.name: Revoke Existing Access Tokens
steps.business_description: System revokes all existing access tokens for the user by setting revoked flag to true in the access_token table

steps.name: Generate New Access Token
steps.business_description: System generates a new JWT access token with 30-minute validity and stores it in the access_token table

steps.name: Revoke Existing Refresh Tokens
steps.business_description: System revokes all existing refresh tokens for the user by setting revoked flag to true in the refresh_token table

steps.name: Generate New Refresh Token
steps.business_description: System generates a new JWT refresh token with 24-hour validity and stores it in the refresh_token table

steps.name: Return Token Response
steps.business_description: System returns HTTP 200 OK with Token payload containing email, access token, and refresh token

variations_and_branches.branch_description: Login fails with CustomException 403 'Invalid username or password'
Login fails with CustomException 403 'Please wait for an email confirmation of your approval'
Login fails with CustomException 403 'Unfortunately, you have not been accepted'
Login fails with CustomException 403 'Your account has been deactivated'
Login fails with BadCredentialsException 'Invalid username or password'

outcomes.description: User authenticated successfully; new access and refresh tokens generated and returned; old tokens revoked
Login fails due to invalid credentials, pending approval, rejection, deactivation, or system error; user receives error response

processes.name: Token Refresh
processes.description: A user with a valid refresh token requests a new access token via the /refresh-token endpoint. The system validates the refresh token, checks if it is expired or revoked, retrieves the associated user, generates a new access token, and returns it to the user.

actors.name: Authenticated User
actors.notes: User with a valid refresh token

actors.name: COVE User Service
actors.notes: Validates refresh token, generates new access token

steps.name: Receive Refresh Token Request
steps.business_description: User submits refresh token via POST /refresh-token endpoint
steps.authorization_notes: Public endpoint; no authentication required (token validated in service layer)

steps.name: Validate Refresh Token
steps.business_description: System validates the refresh token signature, expiration, and revocation status. If invalid, process fails with error.

steps.name: Generate New Access Token
steps.business_description: System generates a new JWT access token with 30-minute validity

steps.name: Return Refresh Token Response
steps.business_description: System returns HTTP 200 OK with RefreshTokenResponse containing the new access token

variations_and_branches.condition_summary: Refresh token is invalid, expired, or revoked
variations_and_branches.branch_description: Process fails with error; user must re-authenticate

outcomes.description: New access token generated and returned; user can continue authenticated session
Token refresh fails due to invalid or expired refresh token; user receives error response and must re-authenticate

processes.name: Admin Account Management
processes.description: An administrator activates or deactivates a user account via the /api/v1/admin/{toEmail}/account-status endpoint. The system updates the user's isActive flag, logs the action in the audit trail, and returns a success response. No email notification is sent for account status changes.

actors.notes: User with ADMIN role who manages user account activation

actors.name: COVE User Service

steps.name: Receive Account Status Update Request

steps.name: Extract Admin Email from Token

steps.name: Save Updated User Entity

relationships.notes: User registration creates a pending approval record that triggers the admin onboarding approval process
Admin approval (with approved status) enables the user to proceed with login
Login generates a refresh token that is used in the token refresh process to obtain new access tokens
Admin account deactivation prevents user login; account activation re-enables login
Admin role management and onboarding approval are independent admin functions that can be performed in any order

faq.question: What happens after a user registers?
faq.answer: After registration, the user receives a pending approval email and must wait for an administrator to review and approve their account. The user cannot log in until approved.

faq.question: How long are access tokens valid?
faq.answer: Access tokens are valid for 30 minutes. Refresh tokens are valid for 24 hours. Users can use the refresh token to obtain a new access token without re-authenticating.

faq.question: What happens if an admin deactivates a user account?
faq.answer: If an admin deactivates a user account, the user will receive an error message when attempting to log in. The user's existing tokens remain valid until they expire, but the user cannot obtain new tokens.

faq.question: Are admin actions audited?
faq.answer: Yes, all admin actions (onboarding approval/rejection, account activation/deactivation, role changes) are logged in the action_history table with timestamps and admin attribution.

faq.question: Can users reset their passwords?
faq.answer: No, password reset functionality is not currently implemented in the system.
